metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2005 · Jarhead
metas.description: A psychological study of Marine's state of mind during the Gulf War. Told through the eyes of a U.S. Marine sniper who struggles to cope with boredom, a sense of isolation, and other issues back home.

metas.name: ★ 6.2 · 2009 · The Men Who Stare at Goats
metas.description: A reporter in Iraq might just have the story of a lifetime when he meets Lyn Cassady, a guy who claims to be a former member of the U.S. Army's New Earth Army, a unit that employs paranormal powers in their missions.
